basis: Canonical Markdown relation review, followed by targeted external source corrections documented in docs/source-corrections.md. This is not a gameplay playtest or a factual audit of every guide.

nacht_der_untoten.notes: Standalone dolls and barrel song; achievement now states the three-round no-entry objective. No native power/PAP.

verruckt.notes: Dolls require toilet song; mannequin location completed using its photo. Acted Alone now specifies 20 headshots from the upstairs/second floor.

shi_no_numa.notes: No native power/PAP. M1911 condition belongs only to the dolls. Zipline explicitly does not count as a trap.

the_giant.notes: Annihilator and extra perk depend on linked teleporters. Musical and visual eggs independent.

kino_der_toten.notes: Reels, rocket figurine and teleporter achievement require the teleporter/PAP route. Paintings, song and dolls do not require the main quest.

ascension.notes: Main quest: four players, power/PAP and monkey-round context. Songs do not imply the main EE. Achievements mix independent goals.

shangri_la.notes: Steps 3–6 and tile matching recovered; four gas leaks corrected; all 54 procedural images rebound to their steps, including eight gong reference photos. Cheatsheet excluded from executable phases.

moon.notes: BO3 Cryogenic Slumber Party distinguished from legacy BO1 Ground Control/One Giant Leap names. Nightmare song no longer references an absent section. Cheatsheet excluded from executable phases.

shadows_of_evil.notes: EE requires rituals/PAP and upgraded sword; shield/Servant/Protector are optional. Purple pods require fumigator. Craft tables illustrate shield and Servant. Rift access is not equivalent to completing PAP.

der_eisendrache.notes: Shared four-plate anti-gravity activation linked to six procedural consumers. Plunger DG-4 position and temporary charge clarified; Church/Mission Control naming and Fire arrow placement corrected.

revelations.notes: Keeper is mandatory at reel 1, base Arnies at holes (upgrade optional), PAP/upgraded Servant at bones. Areas named after other maps never import their guides. Wisp is optional and gated by previous quest completion, masks mostly independent.

origins.notes: G-Strike return/mud reset/second charging stage, distinct 1-1-5 song triggers and red Fire Crystal pedestal clarified. Overachiever now lists the four challenges.

gorod_krovi.notes: Gauntlet and base Dragon Strike depend on Hatchery access. Base shield required for trophy, upgraded shield/Strike optional for EE. Egg heating has two alternatives. Upgrade side files are canonical redirects. Valve table is a case lookup, not thirty sequential tasks.

zetsubou_no_shima.notes: All 16 trials now described; bucket positions transcribed from an author demonstration description (two labelled unfilmed). Masamune wall locations and optional friendly wall separated. Golden Bucket expands four ordinary plant recipes only. Gas-mask prep distinguished from unlocking the elevator.

selection_documents.zetsubou_no_shima:plants.md: Independent plant recipes; choose only the requested normal/fertilized variant.
